comment: Terraria's buff potions. You buy them between rounds and drink them mid-fight with the number keys, so a potion is a decision about when rather than a stat you own. Durations are tuned to cover roughly one round: long enough to matter, short enough that you cannot stay buffed forever. Effects are smaller than Terraria's on purpose, because armor, accessories and prefixes already stack in this game. Sprites are drawn by build_terra_potions.py, not cut from the pack.

potions.name: Ironskin Potion
potions.description: Skin like plate. Everything hits softer.

potions.name: Regeneration Potion
potions.description: Health trickles back on its own.

potions.name: Swiftness Potion
potions.description: Run faster. Not everything has to be fought.

potions.name: Archery Potion
potions.description: Arrows fly faster and land harder.

potions.name: Endurance Potion
potions.description: A tenth of every hit simply does not land.

potions.name: Rage Potion
potions.description: Critical strikes come far more often.

potions.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
potions.description: Mana comes back quickly enough to keep casting.

potions.name: Thorns Potion
potions.description: What touches you takes some of it back.

potions.name: Lifeforce Potion
potions.description: One more heart, for as long as it lasts.

potions.name: Featherfall Potion
potions.description: Drift down instead of dropping. Easier to aim on the way.

potions.name: Heartreach Potion
potions.description: Hearts and coins come to you across the arena.

potions.name: Battle Potion
potions.description: Every coin drop is worth more while it lasts.
